csv_scope_of_work: City of Ellensburg seeks consulting services to develop a Decarbonization Roadmap for municipally owned utility operations, including evaluation of greenhouse gas emissions, decarbonization pathways, costs, risks, infrastructure impacts, governance recommendations, and stakeholder presentations. The City of Ellensburg is seeking qualifications from consulting firms to prepare a Decarbonization Roadmap for its municipally owned utility operations. The selected consultant will evaluate greenhouse gas emissions, analyze decarbonization strategies and pathways, assess costs, risks, infrastructure and operational impacts, develop implementation recommendations, and provide presentations to stakeholders to support future decision-making regarding utility decarbonization
